reader.requirement: At --std 85 the compiler must refuse a separately compiled program in which two programs contained (directly or indirectly) within it carry the same program-name; distinct names, and the outermost program's own name (not a contained program), are outside the rule.
reader.edition-search: CheckDefinitionNameUniqueness uses EditionContext only for At()/Error() (diagnostic position and recording; EditionContext#Error has no edition switch). grep CobolVersion|IsAtLeast|ConstructRegistry|DialectBehavior in BinderDriver.cs finds only comments about VersionConformancePass; the containment walk (Containees over root.Children) is the same at every --std.
reader.witnesses-cover: part: the witness has two sibling containees; a containee nested one level deeper colliding with a sibling of its container, and the positive control, are not exercised by it (probed here)

probes.printed: COBOL2214 program 'C1SUB' contained in 'C1MAIN' repeats the name of another program contained in 'C1MAIN' (exit 65)
probes.expected: refused: two contained programs of one name (X.3.1.3 SR2)

distinct contained names compile and run

a contained program sharing the OUTERMOST program's name is outside SR2's letter (the outermost is not 'contained within'); X.1.3.8.1 permits identical names when one program is contained in a separately compiled program not containing the other: compiles

reader.notes: One walk per outermost program flattens its whole containment subtree into one name set, which is exactly SR2's scope ('contained within the separately compiled program').
